encounter: E0148 TRAINER_JACE (Lavaridge Gym room 7) cap 42 Medium - MIST RERUN f1
availability_audit: Chronology: the Lavaridge Gym sits at the end of the cap-36 window (C22 Mt. Chimney set the cap, C23 is Flannery). Every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Route 102/103/104 (C02-C05), Dewford (C10-C14), Mauville Game Corner and Route 117 (C18-C20), Altering Cave rock-smash with the C18 Rock Smash license. No Surf-gated water (Surf is C27), no Strength-gated area (Strength is granted only after Flannery), no legendary, no post-badge source. All evolution levels are at or below cap 36. Cap-42 re-check for this rerun: window moved 36 -> 42 (FLAG_BADGE04_GET), the window the plan targets ('Medium cap40 levels 43/40/39/40/40/40' = 42 + offset - 2). No member changed, so every source is still a gate<=36 map preceding Lavaridge in book play order. Chronology-legal gate-42 species (Skarmory Route113, Turtonator JaggedPass, Drampa MeteorFalls_1F_1R) were available and not used; the Surf-gated Meteor Falls rooms are not legal here (Surf is C27).
plan: Same rain six. Rain halves the four Fire attackers and Kingdra's Ice Beam plus Garganacl's Rock Slide are both 2x into the Flying half of Drifblim, which is otherwise a 150-base-HP wall at +3. Garganacl is the specific answer to the ghost half of the room: Purifying Salt halves Ghost damage and blocks every status outright, so Hex and Infernal Parade both stay at base power against it. MIST RERUN: this is the second most mist-dependent room after Keegan's, and the checks are asymmetric. Drifblim is Ghost/Flying and therefore ungrounded, so its own Flame Orb SHOULD still burn it and switch Flare Boost on even under the mist - that is the one status the mist must not block. Conversely Salazzle's Toxic and Hisuian Typhlosion's Will-O-Wisp must NOT land on my grounded Kingdra, Swampert, Primarina or Garganacl while the terrain is up, and Corrosion must not bypass that. The interesting decision is Defog: the dossier says Drifblim clears the terrain only when doing so makes the team's status attacks worthwhile, so whether and when the AI chooses Defog is the thing to watch. My airborne Pelipper and Togekiss are the two bodies that remain burnable and poisonable throughout.
